sm-kit-gate.notes: passage crosses the wall; align passage to the road

sm-kit-tower-drum.notes: drops over a corner or wall tile

sm-kit-tower-square.notes: replaces a wall tile; keep a wall tile beneath

sm-tree-deciduous.notes: crown part holds the inner mass and its shade arc; never rotate it

sm-house--desert.notes: flat roof: parapet double-line, no ridge

sm-hut--desert.notes: flat roof with cloth awning; awning overhangs the footprint

sm-longhouse--desert.notes: courtyard cut into the plan; courtyard carries yard fill

sm-house--tundra.notes: steep pitch: ridge at 1.4; two snow drifts at opposite corners

sm-house--tropical.notes: eave inset 3.4u — roof overhangs the footprint; four stilt dots on the eave line

sm-hut--tropical.notes: round thatch, smoke hole, four stilts

sm-longhouse--tropical.notes: eight stilts; ridge along the long axis

sm-well--tropical.notes: deep shaft; wider void than temperate

sm-house--coastal.notes: staggered shingle dashes rather than continuous courses

sm-hut--coastal.notes: drying rack attached east; rack overhangs the footprint

sm-boathouse--coastal.notes: seaward gable cut back with an open mouth; point the mouth at water

sm-palm-date--desert.notes: 7 ribbed fronds; no crown part, no shadow

sm-conifer--tundra.notes: darker needle with a snow cap

sm-snag--tundra.notes: bare snag: stroke only, no canopy fill

sm-dune-grass--coastal.notes: stroke only, no fill; radial blades, top-down like every other mark

sm-inn--desert.notes: flat roof, courtyard with one shade tree, roof stair

sm-chapel--desert.notes: walled precinct, central dome, four corner drums

sm-inn--tundra.notes: steep pitch, stable wing south; wing overhangs the footprint

sm-chapel--tundra.notes: tall narrow hall, lead spire at the crossing, two drifts

sm-inn--tropical.notes: stilted compound around an inner court; six stilts

sm-chapel--tropical.notes: two stacked thatch roofs; grandeur by tier, not height

sm-inn--coastal.notes: shingle courses with the eaves; drying yard south-east

sm-chapel--coastal.notes: shingled hall with a lead spire tower east

sm-green-round-a.notes: ground, not an object: no --sm-ink and no drawn lines inside. The edge is a 4.2u band of darker turf (--sm-common-band) under the --sm-common fill — a worn ring, not an outline — and the interior is a sparse stipple in the same tone, rejection-sampled inside an inset of the outline so no dot lands on the band or outside the patch (density follows area, so narrow shapes get fewer). Uniform scale only — the aspect is drawn in; place the well or cross on top in the structure band; re-tint fill and band together (--sm-yard for market earth, --sm-yard-sand for desert sand)

sm-field-plough.notes: seamless tile — use as an SVG <pattern> with patternTransform for the furrow angle; draws no border of its own; furrow strokes are ~0.5u — a parcel pattern is not scaled by the structure factor, so weight must be judged against the scaled building outline

sm-field-vine.notes: seamless tile — rows run along +x at 0.55u with fill-only plant dots, so the row axis clearly dominates and patternTransform rotation is visible; draws no border of its own

sm-field-paddy--tropical.notes: seamless tile; water is desaturated (--sm-paddy) so a paddy block cannot be mistaken for a river — use as an SVG <pattern> with patternTransform for the furrow angle; draws no border of its own; furrow strokes are ~0.5u — a parcel pattern is not scaled by the structure factor, so weight must be judged against the scaled building outline

sm-edge-hedge.notes: stamp repeated along a generator path, rotated to the local tangent; ink bleeds past both ends so abutting copies overlap; canopy-tokened but stays in parcel — never occludes a building; authored at parcel weight (≤1.0u) so the run never out-inks a building

sm-edge-wall.notes: stamp repeated along a generator path, rotated to the local tangent; ink bleeds past both ends so abutting copies overlap; authored at parcel weight (≤1.0u) so the run never out-inks a building

sm-edge-fence.notes: stamp repeated along a generator path, rotated to the local tangent; ink bleeds past both ends so abutting copies overlap; authored at parcel weight (≤1.0u) so the run never out-inks a building

sm-edge-ditch.notes: stamp repeated along a generator path, rotated to the local tangent; ink bleeds past both ends so abutting copies overlap; shaded side is local south; authored at parcel weight (≤1.0u) so the run never out-inks a building

notes: Parcel-band symbols (greens, field tiles, edge stamps) are changes in the ground, not things standing on it: no -sil twin, they cast no shadow and receive none. Faith and fortification symbols remain biome-agnostic: re-token their fills rather than swapping geometry.
